'''Hindasar''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Hindasar system/Legends|Hindasar system]]<ref name="SWTSE" /> of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Regions']] [[Corpheli sector/Legends|Corpheli sector]].<ref name="TEA-OC" /> After escaping the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on [[Delrian/Legends|Delrian]], [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Cornelius Evazan/Legends|Cornelius Evazan]] purchased a forged medical license and established himself as a personal surgeon. Charging exorbitant fees with the promise of [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-free surgery, Evazan scarred hundreds of beings, with several dozen dying of their wounds.<ref name="SWTSE" />
